# <span class="hero-highlight">Ford Johnson</span>

:::

I’m a data analyst and storyteller specializing in web analytics and big data. With a background in sociology and criminology, I uncover patterns and turn them into engaging narratives.

Learning R sparked my passion for transforming raw data into compelling visuals. Whether analyzing web metrics or crafting custom visuals, I thrive at blending creativity with analysis.

Beyond data, I'm into hiking, photography, and currently learning to golf.
